imageRequirements:
## Required Images
- App icon with warm tan/brown palette on light cream background (app-icon.dim_192x192.png, 192x192)
- App icon with warm tan/brown palette on light cream background; maskable-safe composition (app-icon.dim_512x512.png, 512x512)
- Android adaptive icon foreground graphic, transparent background (android-icon-foreground.dim_432x432.png, 432x432)
- Android adaptive icon background graphic (android-icon-background.dim_432x432.png, 432x432)
- Android splash image with centered app mark on light cream background (android-splash.dim_2732x2732.png, 2732x2732)

new_feature_requests.summary: Add an app icon to the installable app build

Add generated PWA app icon image assets under `frontend/public/assets/generated/` matching the filenames already referenced by the web manifest and favicon link: `app-icon.dim_192x192.png` and `app-icon.dim_512x512.png`.

Add generated Android TWA icon and splash image assets under `frontend/public/assets/generated/` using the filenames documented in `frontend/android/README.md`: `android-icon-foreground.dim_432x432.png`, `android-icon-background.dim_432x432.png`, and `android-splash.dim_2732x2732.png`.

Update the Android TWA wrapper drawable resources to use the generated icon/splash assets, following `frontend/android/README.md`: copy/replace `app/src/main/res/drawable/ic_launcher_foreground.png`, `app/src/main/res/drawable/ic_launcher_background.png`, and `app/src/main/res/drawable/splash_image.png` with the corresponding generated PNGs from `frontend/public/assets/generated/` so the launcher icon (`@mipmap/ic_launcher`) and splash screen (`@drawable/splash_image`) render correctly.

projectName: Add app icon assets for PWA install and Android TWA wrapper
